definitions: An architectural style popular in the mid-20th century, particularly in Miami, characterized by flamboyant, futuristic, and often whimsical designs.
A technology for wireless communication in which multiple antennas are used at both the transmitter and receiver to improve communication performance.
examples: The hotel is a prime example of MiMo architecture.
MiMo technology significantly boosts data transfer rates.
Many buildings in South Florida showcase MiMo elements.
